header.description: Date format conversion routine. Input type 1 and 2 are tested in the code.

copybooks.name: COCDATFT
copybooks.purpose: DSECT for the date conversion parameter area

evidence_summary: Read in full. Called from CBACT01C (app/cbl/CBACT01C.cbl:231).

observations.text: The hyphen check for input type 2 is commented out, so a type-2 date is not rejected for a missing hyphen.

candidate_rules.summary: Input type 1 is rejected when the fifth input character is a hyphen, or when the requested output type is 2. Otherwise the routine inserts hyphens into YYYYMMDD positions.
Input type 2 is rejected when the requested output type is 1. The hyphen positions are removed.
Any other input type moves INVALID INPUT into the error message field.
